purpose: Record the prospectively triggered Gate 6D HALT outcome, document the observed DEV-to-EVAL calibration-transfer failure, and freeze the governance boundary before any calibration-method revision is proposed.

trigger.reason: The frozen selected confidence estimator passed the correctness-discrimination requirement but failed the strict Brier improvement requirement against the frozen DEV-prevalence constant baseline.

secondary_eval_diagnostics.note: These diagnostics help characterize the failure but cannot reverse or redefine the prospectively frozen PASS/HALT decision.

dev_to_eval_diagnostics.interpretation: The observed evidence is consistent with substantial DEV-to-EVAL calibration and correctness-distribution shift. This is a diagnostic interpretation, not proof of a unique causal mechanism.

scientific_interpretation.reason: EVAL AUROC_correct remained above the prospectively defined non-informative boundary of 0.5.
scientific_interpretation.reason_calibration: The selected calibrated probabilities produced worse EVAL Brier score than the frozen constant baseline.
scientific_interpretation.note: The frozen collection and scoring transactions completed successfully. The observed safeguard failure is therefore retained as a scientific outcome unless an independently demonstrated implementation defect is later established.

prohibited_post_eval_actions: Do not refit Platt calibration using the 458 EVAL labels.
Do not select isotonic, identity, VC_SELF_EVAL, or another estimator because it performs better on the already-opened EVAL labels.
Do not relax or redefine the frozen AUROC or Brier safeguard after observing EVAL results.
Do not regenerate the 458 EVAL model outputs as a second attempt.
Do not treat the existing 458-item EVAL set as untouched confirmatory evidence for any method designed after this review.
Do not open Gate 7 or expose participant-facing calibrated confidence while Gate 6 remains halted.
Do not access or repurpose External-TEST for calibration-method selection without a separate explicit prospective amendment.

eval_reuse_policy_after_halt.reason: The EVAL labels and performance are now known and have informed protocol review.

next_review_questions: Determine whether the calibration failure is primarily driven by temporal, capture, prevalence, or confidence-feature instability using development-side and descriptive already-frozen evidence only.
Determine whether a revised confidence estimator can be specified prospectively without fitting or selecting against the opened EVAL outcomes.
Identify a fresh untouched confirmatory evaluation population for any revised Gate 6 method.
Preserve External-TEST for its originally intended role unless an explicit prospective amendment justifies changing that role.
Define the Gate 6 revision PASS/HALT rule before opening any fresh confirmatory labels.
